name: ShrinkLossPreventionLog
tagline: Log every loss, work every case and protect the products that walk out of the door – shrink, investigations and hot products in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete loss-prevention app for stores, hotels and restaurants: log theft, organised retail crime, fraud, damage, spoilage, process errors, supplier shortages and stock-count variances; see known vs unknown and malicious vs non-malicious shrink and shrink % of sales against the target; work the cases on a board with investigators, follow-ups, evidence rules, recoveries and write-off limits; protect hot products and watch their trend; analyse departments, time of day, detection methods and hot spots. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Fast incident logging with auto-fill from known products
Known vs unknown and malicious vs non-malicious shrink
Shrink % of sales against the target with a daily budget line
Case board with drag and drop, investigators and follow-up dates
Evidence rules for theft above a threshold
Partial recoveries and write-off limits by role
Hot products with protection measures, trend and recommended actions
Department × class heat table, time-of-day and weekday analysis
Bulk actions, undo, CSV export and printable incident reports
Power Fx outputs and events (IncidentReportText, SummaryJson)
